items.title: Paul Barbarin Interview, 1960-01-28
items.q: Lucille Higgins, I remember when she recorded that.

ctx.x: Must have been loaded, that's it.

Well, I wasn't loaded, but I don't remember. Larson Buford was a pretty good tuba player, but he doesn't sound like Boyd Cobb. Boyd Cobb still sounds better than he does. Let's see what Bill Moore's going to do now. Try a bell more. Ann Higgins blues. Lucille Higgins, I remember when she recorded that. That's been on quite a while ago. I think you was born. You wasn't born when she recorded that. Ann Higgins blues. I bet I was. Huh?
I bet I was, but I hate to get my age away.
